Replicates and power for a difference between two treatments

Source: R/generator.R
power_design.Rd

Power of the two-sided t-test to detect a difference of diff per cent of the mean between two treatment means, when the coefficient of variation of the trial is cv per cent, as a function of the number of replicates. The error degrees of freedom are those of a CRD or an RCBD with t treatments, and the power uses the noncentral t distribution.

Usage

power_design(
  cv,
  diff,
  t,
  design = c("rcbd", "crd"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  power = 0.8,
  r = 2:30
)

Arguments

cv

Coefficient of variation expected (per cent), from earlier trials on the same site and crop.

diff

Difference to detect, per cent of the mean.

t

Number of treatments.

design

"rcbd" or "crd".

alpha

Significance level.

power

Power wanted.

r

Replicates for which the table is computed.

Value

An object of class "ad_power" with the replicates needed (replicates, NA above 200) and a table with the error df, the power and the detectable difference for each number of replicates.

Examples

power_design(cv = 15, diff = 15, t = 4)
#> 
#> Replicates to detect a difference of 15 % of the mean (CV 15 %, 4 treatments, RCBD, alpha 0.05, power 0.8)
#> Replicates needed: 17 (error df 48)
#> 
#>  Replicates Error df Power Detectable diff. (%)
#>           2        3 0.111                 63.8
#>           3        6 0.179                 41.2
#>           4        9 0.245                 33.4
#>           5       12 0.307                 29.0
#>           6       15 0.368                 26.0
#>           7       18 0.425                 23.8
#>           8       21 0.479                 22.0
#>           9       24 0.530                 20.6
#>          10       27 0.578                 19.5
#>          11       30 0.622                 18.5
#>          12       33 0.662                 17.7
#>          13       36 0.699                 16.9
#>          14       39 0.732                 16.3
#>          15       42 0.763                 15.7
#>          16       45 0.790                 15.2
#> 
#> Halving the CV is worth as much as quadrupling the replicates.
plot(power_design(cv = 10, diff = 15, t = 4))
